item.title: Tina: Code injection via unescaped Git branch name in generated client source
item.description: Score 63/100 MEDIUM — CVSS 8.2 — ### Summary `@tinacms/cli` inserts the raw Git branch value into the generated `client.ts` source without escaping or encoding. A Git-valid branch name can close the string literal and inject an arbitrary JavaScript expression that executes when the consumer build imports the generated client module. Full analysis, Sigma/YARA rules, IOCs, Attack Chain by CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX v4.0.

item.title: Nginx UI: Unauthenticated signed-request body staging can exhaust temporary storage
item.description: Score 61/100 MEDIUM — CVSS 7.5 — ## Summary In Nginx UI versions 2.5.0 through 2.5.x, the node-signature authentication path staged an attacker-controlled request body in a temporary file and synchronized it to disk before validating the body digest and cryptographic signature. An unauthenticated remote client that can reach the AP. Full analysis, Sigma/YARA rules, IOCs, Attack Chain by CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX v4.0.

item.title: @tinacms/web-components: `tina-markdown` writes rich-text link URLs into `href` without scheme validation, allowing stored XSS
item.description: Score 61/100 MEDIUM — CVSS 7.6 — ### Summary ` ` renders a rich-text AST into the DOM and, for `a` nodes, assigns the node's URL straight to the anchor's `href` with no scheme check. A link authored in the CMS as `javascript:…` renders as a live `javascript:` anchor, so a visitor who clicks it executes attacker-supplied script in t. Full analysis, Sigma/YARA rules, IOCs, Attack Chain by CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX v4.0.
